title: Modern Luxury Loft in Historic Downtown Gallatin
description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located and newly renovated building a block from historic Gallatin TN square. Located walking distance to shops, restaurants and so much more. Only 25 miles to Nashville. This 1 Bedroom apartment is brand new and complete with a cozy bed, fully stocked kitchen, a pull out queen sized couch, washer/dryer and new appliances. Hosts provide coffee and tea service in the kitchen, toiletries in the bathroom and a fully furnished rooftop patio!

The space
The Claiborne building is home to 3 residential apartments located on the 2nd floor and two commercial spaces at ground level.  Dogs are welcome through a reservation for a pet fee, but no cats please.  Dogs must be kept on a leash and are not to be left unattended. 

Guest will provide a starter supply only and guests should purchase additional items as needed.

Guest access
Guests will access the building through the secure 2nd floor entrance and will find their private apartment entry in the vestibule. Guests will also have access to a uniquely furnished rooftop terrace, perfect for sipping morning coffee or enjoying an evening beverage while catching a sunset.

Other things to note
Parking for Airbnb guests is front of building designated and reserved with the orange cones. (Driveway parking is for long term tenants only).
